# Kilo

> Kilo is an ultra-fast, in-memory client-side image compression and modern format converter web application. It transforms heavy megabyte (MB) assets into lightweight, high-performance kilobytes (KB) directly in the browser with zero server storage and complete user privacy.

Kilo is engineered for web developers, designers, and e-commerce merchants (including Shopify store owners). It provides lossless and lossy compression for WebP, PNG, JPEG, AVIF, and multi-resolution Windows Favicon (.ICO) generation.

## Key Features

- In-Memory Processing: 100% client-side compression using HTML5 Canvas and browser APIs. Files never leave the user device.
- Zero Server Storage: Zero data retention, fully GDPR and CCPA compliant by design.
- Multi-Format Support: Compress and convert between WebP, PNG, JPEG, SVG, AVIF, and ICO.
- Shopify Integration: Streamline product imagery and asset optimization for Shopify merchants via Stockly.
- Responsive & Light: Built on React Router v7 with zero bloat and near-instant load times.
